text:
Amy: Quick sync — Acme wants to embed the Redwood SDK into their desktop app for a joint POC. They asked about: licensing for embedded SDK, dataflow (they insist customer data stays in their VPC), telemetry/telemetry opt-out, and pricing model (per-request vs per-token). Anyone pick this up?
Sanjay: I can own the SDK integration + arch notes. Need to confirm offline mode (calls only on cache miss) and exact license terms. CC Olivia for security questionnaire.
Olivia: Heads-up: we must confirm we are not shipping model weights to the client. Key items: TLS1.3 mandatory, mTLS preferred, no persistent logs with PII, KMS/HSM for API keys, and DPA/SOC2 required. Share their IdP (SAML/OIDC).
Lee: Pricing note — embedded scenarios usually map to Dedicated pricing for predictable throughput. We can add a small per-request surcharge for cache-miss calls from partner infra. I’ll draft a ballpark.
Amy: They asked whether a local Redis-based cache on the client is allowed (to reduce egress). Also asked about offline anonymization before sending.
Sanjay: Arch suggestion: client maintains prefix/embedding cache; on miss, SDK calls Private endpoint inside their VPC — that keeps data in their network. SDK should expose cache hook API. We must enforce that the SDK does NOT store model files locally.
Sanjay: Example config snippet for the partner SDK (for their engs):
```json
{
  "redwood_endpoint": "https://private.acme.redwood.example.com",
  "auth": "api_key",
  "cache": {"backend": "redis", "enabled": true, "ttl_seconds": 86400},
  "telemetry": {"enabled": false, "collection_level": "minimal"}
}
```
Olivia: Security Qs from my side they will answer: 1) Will any user-generated content be stored on our side? 2) Are they using client-side hashing/anonymization? 3) Who holds the KMS? If they want on-prem KMS, we need to validate compatibility. I’ll send the questionnaire template.
Amy: They want to hash emails client-side before sending. How does that affect embedding quality?
Sanjay: Hashing reduces semantic signal. Recommend PII redaction (remove/replace tokens) or deterministic salt + local redact step, then run a small eval on 500 queries to measure quality delta. We should surface the tradeoff to the customer.
Lee: Action on pricing: propose Dedicated baseline + tiered usage for cache misses: e.g., reserved monthly GPU + $0.25 per 1k cache-miss embedding requests (placeholder). Include 24/7 support addon and SLA terms for the POC.
Amy: Action items: Sanjay — draft SDK integration guide + sample config and run quick eval plan. Olivia — prepare security addendum + questionnaire and flag absolute blockers. Lee — provisional quote and options (reserved vs burst). I’ll coordinate call with Acme for Thursday 10am PT.
zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Acme embedded SDK POC kickoff" — Thu 10:00 AM PT. Invite sent.
Sanjay: I'll post a short PR with SDK hooks and cache examples before the call.
Olivia: Sending questionnaire doc in DM. Please don't share until reviewed.
Lee: +1 on timeline. I'll include cost ranges and opt-in telemetry toggles. :thumbsup:
Amy: Thanks — will loop in AM to confirm IdP and sample dataset for the eval.
